rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Primordial high light descended through stages into the worldly creation, then its luminosity was concealed in a human whom God selected and purified.
rows.anchor: ولما كان أصل الإبداء نورا عليا نزله الحق سبحانه وتعالى في رتب التطوير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God selected Adam for knowledge, messengership, and caliphate; made from dust, Adam is an even more extraordinary precedent than Jesus, who lacked a father.
rows.anchor: أي للعلم والرسالة عنه سبحانه وتعالى إلى خلقه والخلافة له في ملكه

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Adam’s name derives from the earth’s surface (adīm), and its pattern أفعل marks the fullest realization of human and earthly nature.
rows.anchor: التي هي نهاية كمال الآدمية والأديمية

rows.speaker: علي
rows.claim: Ali says God displayed Adam’s special prior knowledge to the angels by teaching him the names, made him a sanctuary and qibla, and alerted him to the trust after naming him imam.
rows.anchor: علي رضي الله عنه في قوله : لما خلق الله سبحانه وتعالى أبان فضله للملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah is the second forefather, born from two young parents in the ordinary way familiar to humanity.
rows.anchor: الذي أخرجه من بين أبوين شابين على عادتكم المستمرة فيكم

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Noah’s selection complements Adam’s and advances toward spiritual existence: as the first messenger, he repudiated idolatry and established monotheistic faith.
rows.anchor: اصطفى نوحا عليه الصلاة والسلام بما جعله أول رسول بتوحيده من حيث دحض الشرك

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The flood purified Noah and his saved descendants from the corrupt lineage destroyed with the unbelievers, completing the purification begun with Adam.
rows.anchor: فكان هذا الاصطفاء اصطفاء باطنا لذلك الاصطفاء الظاهر فتأكد الاصطفاء وجرى من أهلكته طامة الطوفان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The chain of selection extracts purity from Noah’s selected lineage, then from Adam’s; the citation of God choosing Moses illustrates this pattern.
rows.anchor: فكان هذا الاصطفاء استخلاص صفاوة من صفاوة نوح عليه الصلاة والسلام المستخلصين من صفاوة آدم عليه الصلاة والسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The family of Imran here means Mary and Jesus, completing a line from Adam to Jesus that encompasses both spiritual and genealogical existence.
rows.anchor: مريم وعيسى عليهما الصلاة والسلام ليقع الاصطفاء في نمط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God selected Adam, Noah, and the families of Abraham and Imran over the people of their respective eras; the created world signals the manifestation of divine kingship.
rows.anchor: وكذلك نوحا وآل إبراهيم وآل عمران كلا على عالم زمانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling Jesus part of a lineage prevents confusion between his miraculous creation and divinity: God neither begets nor is begotten, and has no equal.
rows.anchor: لأن الله سبحانه وتعالى لم يلد ولم يولد ولم يكن له كفوا أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The accusative ذرية functions as a circumstantial expression, characterizing the selection as a connected lineage.
rows.anchor: الذي يسميه النحاة حالا - انتهى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s hearing and knowledge explain that these people were selected with complete knowledge, encouraging others to emulate their conduct and words.
rows.anchor: اصطفاهم على تمام العلم بهم ترغيبا في أحوالهم والاقتداء بأفعالهم وأقوالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the preceding selections, the narrative turns to Imran’s family because its central concern is their extraordinary birth and the honor given to Mary.
rows.anchor: ولما كان جل المقصود هنا بيان الكرامات في آل عمران لا سيما في الولادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إذ introduces a response to people disputing or asking about the family, and the woman is identified as pregnant when she speaks.
rows.anchor: جوابا لمن يجادلك في أمرهم ويسألك عن حالهم

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Only Jesus receives detailed treatment because the earlier figures introduce his case; the account parallels Adam’s creation in al-Baqara with Jesus’ creation here.
rows.anchor: إنما ذكر توطئة لأمر عيسى عليه الصلاة والسلام اختص التفصيل بأمر عيسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Vowing a child to God was customary among the Israelites, but they expected a son because males served at the sanctuary.
rows.anchor: وكان نذر الولد شائعا في بني إسرائيل إلا أنه كان عندهم معهودا في الذكور لصلاحهم لسدانة بيت الله

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: A prophetic report says many men attained perfection, but among women only four did; Mary, daughter of Imran, is named among them.
rows.anchor: قال عليه أفضل الصلاة وأزكى السلام ( كمل من الرجال كثير ولم يكمل من النساء إلا

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Mary’s mother relinquished her child while still most attached to her in the womb; the account compares this separation with Abraham’s commanded sacrifice of his son at maturity.
rows.anchor: التي لها الإشفاق , فكان الولد أباه فحينئذ يترقى إلى حزب أبيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The child is dedicated to God, beyond the authority or claims of any created person.
rows.anchor: أي لا اعتراض ولا حكم لأحد من الخلق عليه

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Taḥrīr means seeking freedom; its intensified form conveys firm, complete severance of human guardianship so the child belongs to God.
rows.anchor: والحرية رفع اليد عن الشيء من كل وجه

words: فتقبل مني إنك أنت السميع العليم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She asks for acceptance and grounds the plea in God’s encompassing hearing and knowledge, affirming that these belong to Him alone.
rows.anchor: عللت سؤالها في التقبل بأن قصرت السمع والعلم عليه سبحانه

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The tafaʿʿul form echoes the mother’s request and suggests acceptance unfolding through successive stages, with blessing renewed as Mary develops.
rows.anchor: فجاء بصيغة التفعل مطابقة لقولها

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Calling God her Lord and describing the acceptance as good reveals the inward grace of the answer and extends its meaning.
rows.anchor: وظهر سر الإجابة في قوله سبحانه وتعالى

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The form-IV verb and the verbal noun distinguish hidden nourishment and growth from the visible perfection of Mary’s bodily development.
rows.anchor: وفي ذكر الفعل من ( أفعل ) في قوله : { وأنبتها } والاسم من ( فعل )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s care vindicates Mary: those who slandered her lied, while those who exalted her son beyond measure fell into unbelief and excess.
rows.anchor: فلقد ضل وافترى من قذفها وبهتها , وكفر وغلا من ادعى

words: فتقبلها ربها بقبول حسن وأنبتها نباتا حسنا
rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: This sura’s account of Mary’s acceptance, growth, and conduct removes confusion about her and her son; repeated Qur’anic stories vary in detail to suit each sura’s purpose.
rows.anchor: من تقبلها وإنباتها وحسن سيرتها بما نفي اللبس في أمرها وأمر ولدها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since a child ordinarily needs an adult to care for her, God appointed Zakariya as Mary’s guardian.
rows.anchor: ولما كان الصغير لا بد له فيما جرت به العادة من كبير يتولى أمره قال

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The root of kafāla conveys encompassing protection, as if the guardian surrounds the one entrusted to him like an enclosing sphere.
rows.anchor: من الكفل وهو حياطة الشيء من جميع جهاته حتى يصير عليه كالفلك الدائر

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The reading with a doubled fāʾ indicates that God is Mary’s true guarantor through His acceptance, while Zakariya serves as His deputy.
rows.anchor: وفي قراءة التشديد إنباء بأن الله سبحانه وتعالى هو في الحقيقة كفيلها

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The miḥrāb is the front and foremost part of a house, difficult to reach without special strength and effort.
rows.anchor: هو صدر لابيت ومقدمه الذي لا يكاد يوصل إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated visits show Zakariya checking on Mary’s needs, yet God had already supplied her with sustenance from the unseen.
rows.anchor: وفي هذه العبارة أي من أولها إلاحة لمعنى حسن كفالته وأنه كان يتفقدها عند تقدير حاجتها إلى الطعام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage’s provision resembles the cluster of grapes found with Khubayb ibn ʿAdī al-Anṣārī; the author says many such instances occurred in this community.
rows.anchor: كما وجد عند خبيب بن عدي الأنصاري رضي الله تعالى عنه قطف العنب

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: God’s unseen provision nourishes the one He has Himself cultivated and prepares Mary to receive His spirit and Word, while shielding her from ordinary entanglements.
rows.anchor: فيجد الكفيل الحق قد عاجلها برزق من غيب بما هو سبحانه وتعالى المتولي لإنباتها

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Although Zakariya outwardly guarded Mary, she inwardly became his guardian when God disclosed to him through her what he had not previously known.
rows.anchor: وكانت هي مثل ما كفلها كافلها ظاهرا كفلته باطنا حين أبدى الله سبحانه وتعالى له من أمره

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Mary’s placement in the miḥrāb signals her inward completeness; for a devoted recluse, the house itself is a sanctuary for prayer and eating.
rows.anchor: وفي تعيين محلها بالمحراب ما يليح معنى ما ذكر من رجوليتها باطنا

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The devoted should remain present-hearted during meals as in prayer: attention at the table enables attention in worship, and vice versa.
rows.anchor: من غفل عند طعامه قلبه لم يستطع أن يحضر في صلاته قلبه , ومن حضر عند طعامه

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The indefinite, unqualified word رزق suggests that Mary received various kinds of provision.
rows.anchor: وفي ذكر الرزق شائعا إشعار بأنها أنواع من أرزاق

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: أنى expresses Zakariya’s wonder at the provision’s unusual timing, location, and manner of arrival.
rows.anchor: كلمة أنى تشعر باستغرابه وجود ذلك الرزق من وجوه مختلفة : من جهة الزمان

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The pronoun هو points to the provision’s full reality rather than its individual items, describing insight of the heart rather than sight of the eye.
rows.anchor: فهو إنباء عن رؤية قلب , لا عن نظر عين لأن هو كلمة إضمار

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Divine provision is ranked as customary, from God’s presence, or from His innermost presence; عند is the middle rank, beyond ordinary causes but below لدن.
rows.anchor: فهي ثلاث رتب : رتبة لدنية , ورتبة عندية , ورتبة حكمية عادية

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The account compares the unusual provision with knowledge from God’s innermost presence, Moses’ description of an astonishing act, and Solomon’s ordinary royal capacity as God’s favor.
rows.anchor: آتيناه رحمة من عندنا وعلمناه من لدنه علما

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: إمر means a wonder; provision without reckoning is continuous giving that is neither delimited nor enumerated.
rows.anchor: والإمر العجب , ولعلو رتبته عن الرتبة العادية

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The phrase names God directly because the provision exceeds customary causal processes; calling it from one’s Lord can suggest familiar material means.
rows.anchor: ولعلو رتبته عن الرتبة العادية جرى النبأ عنه مضافا إلى الاسم العظيم

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Repeating the name Allah signals the breadth of the event and that God may grant such provision to Zakariya and whomever He wills.
rows.anchor: في تجديد الاسم العظيم في النبأ إشعار باتساع النبأ وإيذان وإلاحة بأن ذلك يكون لك ولمن شاء الله

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Because accounted allotments in this life entail reckoning at return, unreckoned provision heralds release from afterlife accounting; gratitude begins by recognizing that sustenance comes from God.
rows.anchor: كل محسوب في الإبداء محاسب عليه في الإعادة , فكان في الرزق بغير حساب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At that significant time and place, Zakariya remembered the generosity shown to Mary and prayed to his Lord.
rows.anchor: أي في ذلك الوقت وذلك المكان العظيمي المقدار

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Seeing God break customary patterns for the woman in his care—who spiritually cared for him—moved Zakariya to ask for a child beyond its usual season.
rows.anchor: لما أشهده الله سبحانه وتعالى أنه يخرق عادئته لمن شاء بكلمته في حق كفيلته في الظاهر

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: من لدنك asks for a more inward gift than من عندك, as in knowledge and compassion granted from God’s innermost presence.
rows.anchor: طلب عليه من باطن الأمر كما قال سبحانه وتعالى

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: ذرية suggests abundance and continuing descendants; he receives one son at the end of the natural period, without descendants, whose human nature is dominated by spirituality.
rows.anchor: فيه إشعار بكثرة ونسل باق , فأجيب بولد فرد لما كان زمان انتهاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A good offspring here means obedient to God, the kind of request made by the spiritually discerning.
rows.anchor: أي مطيعة لك لأن ذلك طلبة أهل الخصوص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears and answers prayer because He is capable; idols cannot hear, and even if they could, they lack power to respond.
rows.anchor: لأن من شأن من يسمع - ولم يمنع - أن يجب إذا كان قادرا

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: Affirming that God hears prayer informs the supplicant of His responsiveness and nearness, helping secure acceptance.
rows.anchor: أعلم الداعي بما لله سبحانه وتعالى من الإجاة

words: ذلك من أنباء الغيب نوحيه إليك
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These exact, remarkable reports of hidden Israelite history should awaken listeners and prove the Prophet truthful, since he had no contact with scholars or access to such knowledge.
rows.anchor: الغريبة المحررة العجيبة التي لا يعرفها على وجهها إلا الحذاق من علماء بني إسرائيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ذلك points to the elevated, truthful, and finely ordered discourse; نوحيه describes revelation being renewed in accounts like this.
rows.anchor: أي الخطاب العلي المقام الصادق المرام البديع النظام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that the Prophet was not present may be read as a circumstantial clause: while you were not with them.
rows.anchor: أن تكون الجملة حالا تقديرها : { و } الحال أنك

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: لدى denotes presence with something of elevated status.
rows.anchor: لدى هي عند حاضرة لرفعة ذلك الشيء الذي ينبأ به عنه

rows.speaker: الحرالي
rows.claim: The pens were cast for drawing lots; a pen is a visible trace that points to what lies beyond it.
rows.anchor: جمع قلم , وهو مظهر الآثار المنبئة عما وراءها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They drew lots to decide who would foster Mary, competing for the honor because of the distinction God had granted her.
rows.anchor: أي يحضنها ويربيها تنافسا في أمرها لما شرفها الله تعالى به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet had neither witnessed their dispute nor learned its details from people; his known distance from scholars and literary training leaves revelation as the source.
rows.anchor: ومن الواضح الجلي أن بعد نسبتك إلى التعلم من البشر كبعد نسبتك إلى الحضور بينهم في ذلك الوقت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reminder appears near the middle of the story so listeners recall what preceded it and attend to what follows.
rows.anchor: وجعل هذا التنبيه في نحو وسط هذا القصص ليكون السامع على ذكر مما مضى ويلقي السمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The notice follows Mary’s opening story to emphasize that she is central to the account, which answers the Christians of Najran.
rows.anchor: وجعله بعد الافتتاح بقصة مريم عليها السلام تنبيها على عظم شأنها وأنها المقصودة بالذات للرد على وفد نصارى نجران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cast lots are obscure even to most scriptural experts; their pens also foreshadow the announcement of one who will be taught the Book.
rows.anchor: واختصامهم في كفالتها لخفائه إلى على خواص أهل الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The second إذ replaces the first, marking the parenthetical note about the lots and dispute as an insertion serving an important purpose.
rows.anchor: مبدلا من إذ الأولى إيذانا بأن ما بيناه اعتراض لما نبه عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Using Allah’s comprehensive proper name in this sura of divine oneness underscores His unmatched majesty and the certainty of His command.
rows.anchor: سورة التوحيد المقتضي للتفرد بالعظمة عبر ما صدرت به من اسم الذات الجامع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus begins from God without a father; calling him a Word names the effect by its cause, a formulation apt to the sura’s purpose and refuting polemical claims.
rows.anchor: من غير واسطة أب هو من تسمية المسبب باسم السبب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The masculine pronoun in اسمه shows that the intended referent is not the word itself but what comes from it and acts through it.
rows.anchor: بل ما يكون عنها ويكون فعالا بها فقال مذكرا للضمير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In Jewish law, anointing with holy oil marked someone as purified and eligible for kingship, knowledge, and virtues; Jesus bears this blessing without having been anointed.
rows.anchor: من مسحه الإمام بدهن القدس كان طاهرا متأهلا للملك والعلم والمزايا الفاضلة مباركا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Dajjal may be called al-Masih because Jesus will kill him, a name given by opposition, or because he remains impure and cannot be cleansed by anointing.
rows.anchor: فإما أن يكون لما كان هلاكه على يد عيسى عليه الصلاة واسلام وصف بوصفه
